typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MemberID as string,
		Result as string,
		Removal_Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT Subscriber_or_family_ID_number AS MemberID, value as Result, Removal_Date  FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.IA_HCBS_CAHPS_EXTRACT CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(Removal_Result, \',\') WHERE Removal_Date =  CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTableIAHCBSCAHPSEXTRACTRemoval
SourceTableIAHCBSCAHPSEXTRACTRemoval derive(MemberID = MemberID) ~> PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount
PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount sink(input(
		MemberID as string,
		RemovalDate as string,
		Result as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MemberID,
		RemovalDate = Removal_Date,
		Result)) ~> TargetIAHCBSRemoval
